query: Section 232 aluminum country of smelt and cast reporting requirements

statements.text: If the country of smelt or cast is unknown, importers must: - Report “UN” (unknown) in place of the ISO country code in the Importer’s Additional Declaration Record (Record Type ‘07’).

Effective June 28, 2025, for imports of derivative aluminum subject to Section 232 measures, if importers do not know the country of smelt and/or cast then the importers should report “unknown” in lieu of the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) code for the unknown smelt and cast country.

For such situations for aluminum derivative HTS classifications, where the aluminum country of smelt and cast is required, report “Y” for the secondary country of smelt, and report the country reported as the country of origin of the non-aluminum article as the secondary country of smelt code, and as the country of cast.
All importers of aluminum and derivative aluminum subject to Section 232 must report: - Primary country of smelt using an ISO country code and a “Y” indicator.

For the Importer's Additional Declaration Record Type '07' if either the derivative aluminum primary and/or secondary country of smelt or country of cast is unknown, report ‘UN’ (unknown) for the ISO country code.
